body:
🛡️ AntiAdminAbuse

AntiAdminAbuse is a powerful moderation and transparency plugin designed to prevent admin abuse and keep server actions visible and accountable.

🔍 Key Features

Command Logging

Logs all player and console commands to daily log files

Stores per-player command history (up to 100 commands each)

Includes timestamps and IP addresses (where available)

Dangerous Command Confirmation

Commands like /op, /give, /tp, /ban, /stop, and more require double execution within 10 seconds

Prevents accidental or malicious admin actions

Broadcasts warnings when dangerous commands are attempted

Live Command Broadcasting

Broadcast admin/console commands to all players

Multiple display modes:

Chat

Action Bar

Boss Bar

Title

Subtitle

Filtered commands (e.g. /msg, /tell, /whisper) are hidden for privacy

Admin Control Commands

/antiadmin enable – Enable broadcasting & protections

/antiadmin disable – Disable broadcasting

/antiadmin displayType <type> – Change how alerts are shown

/antiadmin history <player> – View a player’s recent command history

Persistent History

Command history is saved to disk and restored on server restart

🎯 Why Use AntiAdminAbuse?

Prevents silent abuse by admins or compromised accounts

Adds accountability without removing admin power

Ideal for SMPs, community servers, and semi-public servers

Fully configurable and lightweight

🔐 Permissions

antiadmin.manage – Required to manage the plugin
